बुध् {c1c} U., {c4c} A. (बोधति-ते, बुध्यते,
बुद्ध)
1 To know, understand,
comprehend; क्रमादमुं नारद इत्यबोधि सः
Śi. 1. 3; 9. 24; नाबुद्ध कल्पद्रुमतां विहाय
जातं तमात्मन्यसिपत्रवृक्षं

.
--2 To perceive, notice, recognise,
mark; हिरण्मयं र्हंसमबोधि नैषधः

; 12. 39.
--3 To deem,
regard, consider^1, esteem &c.
--4 To
heed, attend to.
--5 To think, reflect.
--6 To wake up, awake, rise from
sleep; दददपि गिरमंतर्बुध्यते नो मनुष्यः
Śi. 11. 4; ते च प्रापुरुदन्वंतं बुबुधे
चादिपूरुषः

.
--7 To regain
consciousness, to come to one's senses;
शनैरबोधि सुग्रीवः सोऽलुंचीत्कर्णनासिकं

.
--8 To advise, admonish.
[]
--Caus. (बोधयति-ते)
1 To cause to
know, make known, inform, acquaint
with.
--2 To teach, communicate,
impart.
--3 To advise, admonish;
बोधयंतं हिताहितं

.
--4 To revive, restore to life, bring
to senses or consciousness.
--5 To
remind, put in mind of; स्मर्षियति
त्वां न स बोधितोऽपि सन् Ś. 4. 1.
--6 To
wake up, rouse, excite (fig.); अकाले
बोधितो भ्रात्रा

.
--7
To revive the scent (of a perfume).
--8 To cause to expand, open;
मधुरवा मधुबोधितमाधवी Śi. 6. 20; सविता
बोधयति पंकजान्येव Ś. 5. 28.
--9 To
signify, convey, indicate. --Desid.
(बुबु-बो-धिषति-ते, बुभुत्सते) To wish to
know &c.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar and Jim Funderburk on 20210104. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/20.

बुध a. [बुध्-क]
1 Wise, clever,
learned.
--2 Intelligent.
--3 Waking,
awaking.
--धः
1 A wise or learned
man; निपीय यस्य क्षितिरक्षिणः कथां
तथाद्रियंते न बुधाः सुधामपि

.
--3 The planet
Mercury; रक्षत्येनं तु बुधयोगः

; 13. 76.
--धा Spikenard.
--Comp.
--जनः a wise or learned
man.
--तातः the moon.
--दिनं, --वारः
वासरः Wednesday.
--रत्नं an emerald.
--सुतः an epithet of Purūravas.

बुधान^1 a. [बुध्-अनच् किच्च]
1 One
who teaches the Vedas
--2
Speaking kindly.
--3 Wise, learned,
prudent.
--4 Waking (Ved.).
1 A
wise man, sage.
--2 A holy
teacher, spiritual guide.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,.

बुध्य a.
1 Observable, noteworthy.
--2 To be awaked or roused.

1 The bottom of a vessel.
--2
The foot of a tree.
--3 The lowest
part.
--4 An epithet of Śiva. (Also
बुध्न्य in the last sense).
--5 The
body.
--6 Ved. The sky.
